meta.name: gaai-oss-deliver
meta.description: Implement validated GAAI OSS backlog Stories by activating the Delivery Agent and applying backlog-first delivery rules.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动从待办列表交付已验证的开发任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化执行产品待办列表中的开发故事
copy.tagline_en: Automate delivery of validated backlog stories
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate the execution of product backlog stories

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会读取项目中的 GAAI 规则和待办事项文件，仅执行已验证的待办项，并在实施后报告验证结果。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 执行 `.gaai/project/contexts/backlog/active.backlog.yaml` 中的待办工作，或主动说“实施待办”时触发。

say.text: 请从活动待办中选择一个已验证的故事来实施。
say.note: Claude 会读取待办并执行第一个就绪项。
Claude 会加载该故事的具体文件并实施。

say.text: 查看当前待办并实施下一个就绪的故事。
say.note: Claude 会列出待办项并自动实施。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude reads GAAI rules and backlog files, then implements only validated backlog stories and reports verification results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to execute work from `.gaai/project/contexts/backlog/active.backlog.yaml` or say "implement backlog".

say_en.text: Please pick a validated story from the active backlog and implement it.
say_en.note: Claude reads backlog and executes the first ready item.

say_en.text: Implement story ID-123 from the backlog.
say_en.note: Claude loads that story's specific artefacts and implements.

say_en.text: View current backlog and implement the next ready story.
say_en.note: Claude lists backlog items and automatically implements.
